title: API ExpandQuestHeader
wikitext:
Expands the quest header.
 ExpandQuestHeader(questID);
----

; ''Arguments''

: (Number questID)

:; questID
:: The quest ID of the header you wish to expand

----

; ''Returns''

:; nil

----

; ''Example''

 ExpandQuestHeader(3);

; ''Result''

----

; ''Description''

: Expands the quest header.
